response.what_it_is: Brother SE630 computerized sewing and embroidery machine
hidden_risks: LCD touchscreen functionality and display condition
Internal motherboard and motor operational status
Completeness of embroidery hoops, feet, and power accessories
response.best_proof: A video demonstrating the machine powered on, navigating the touchscreen, and stitching/embroidering successfully.
response.failure_mode: Mistaking it for an industrial sewing machine or missing that it is a computerized embroidery machine with an electronic display.
